purpose: perform one supported Accessibility action on a previously resolved approved element.

source.source_text: Purpose: perform one supported Accessibility action on a previously resolved approved element. Input: element_ref:string, action:press|select|increment|decrement|show_menu|focus. Output: action result plus re-observed postcondition. Contract: L4 writes_local; scope mac.ui.control; target ui_element; timeout 15000ms; cap 256KiB; no network/filesystem; sensitive dialogs/security/credential UI denied; approval trusted_gui; non-idempotent unless action semantics are inherently safe. Phase 4 planned.
